title: Liquid Biopsies in Pediatric Solid Tumors
official: Liquid Biopsies in Non-CNS Malignant Pediatric Solid Tumors
summary: This study is being done to determine if traces of tumor can be found in the blood before, during, and after patients stop treatment. We will analyze the tumor material to see if it is similar to tumor tissue and if the tumor material in blood is helpful in monitoring the disease.
conditions: Pediatric Solid Tumor, Unspecified, Protocol Specific
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newly diagnosed, relapsed, or refractory histologically confirmed high grade bone or soft tissue sarcoma or malignant renal, thyroid, germ cell, or hepatic tumors, OR
* Healthy individual with no history of cancer or chronic medical problems and \< 21 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* CNS Malignancies
* Individuals \< 6 months of age
